description: Property-based testing for web and terminal UIs

latest_release.name: v0.8.0
latest_release.body:
Breaking changes:

* The new binary trace format used for all drivers breaks forward and backwards
  compatibility between 0.8.x and prior versions, with regard to traces. JSONL
  output can be produced with the new `bombadil trace` command, using the
  `--json` option, for processing with tools like `jq`.
* The `--output-path` option now names a file (or a template for fuzzer run
  output files) and not a directory. The parent directory has to exist.

Major updates:

* Support chrome-headless-shell for up to 4x higher throughput (#360, #467)
* Store traces in compressed binary format (#393, #391, #399, #441, #445)
* Render campaign summary with inspect hint and use proper exit codes (#461)
* Add `bombadil trace` command to show binary traces (#395)

Minor updates:

* Terminal driver performance improvements (#409, #411)
* Reject invalid action tree weights with a clear error (#465)
* Close tabs opened by the page, avoiding hangs (#420)
* Record browser block hits in traces, add --coverage-symbols (#416)
* Stable source and block ids for browser code coverage (#415)
* Expose abstract snapshots for future targeted fuzzing support (#418, #421)

Bug fixes:

* Fix stale screenshot issues in regular Chrome/Chromium screenshot capture
  (#360)

Internal:

* Smoke test fuzz commands in CI (#462)
* Upgrade Ghostty dependencies (#392, #408)
* Match action with producing template (#422)
* Flatten action tree once per step, recording offered templates and the one
  taken (#414, #417)

hot_issues.title: Use Duration instead of SystemTime in trace

# Bombadil Property-based testing for web and terminal UIs, autonomously exploring and validating correctness properties, *finding harder bugs earlier*. Runs in your local developer environment, in CI, and inside Antithesis. ## Documentation Learn all about Bombadil with the following resources: * [The Bombadil Manual](https://antithesishq.github.io/bombadil/) * [Installation](https://antithesishq.github.io/bombadil/browser/2.1-installation.html) * [Examples](https://antithesishq.github.io/bombadil/browser/3.7-examples.html) ## Join us Join us on our quest to reinvent how the world thinks about software reliability. [We are hiring.](https://antithesis.com/company/careers/?ashby_jid=88f9ee26-c86f-4625-9ac2-cb268678044a#open-roles) Or, if you want to hack on it, see [Contributing](docs/development/contributing.md). We prefer GitHub issues and [Discord discussions](https://discord.gg/antithesis) over drive-by pull requests. Make sure you read the [Gen AI Policy](docs/development/gen-ai-policy.md) before using LLMs in your contributions.
> Old Tom Bombadil is a merry fellow,
> Bright blue his jacket is, and his boots are yellow.
> Bugs have never fooled him yet, for Tom, he is the Master:
> His specs are stronger specs, and his fuzzer is faster. Built by [Antithesis](https://antithesis.com).
